name: Paralyzing Bite
body:
Your massive jaws crush vertebrae and sever nerves, possibly crippling an opponent.

Prerequisites: Str 13, Jaws of Death, base attack bonus +14, bite attack, hulk racial trait, lizardfolk.

Benefit: Any creature that suffers a critical hit from your bite attack is also paralyzed for a number of rounds equal to your Strength modifier. The effects of this feat do not stack.

Additional hits instead add to the effect’s duration.
